class Solution:
    def earliestSecondToMarkIndices(self, nums, changeIndices):
        n = len(nums)
        m = len(changeIndices)
        
        def check(s):
            # last occurrence of each index in changeIndices[0..s-1]
            last = {}
            for i in range(s):
                last[changeIndices[i]] = i
            # all indices must appear
            if len(last) < n:
                return False
            # greedy: at each second, if it's the last occurrence of changeIndices[i] and nums is satisfied, mark it
            # otherwise use it to decrement
            marked = 0
            decrements_available = 0
            # simulate: count free seconds
            # at second i (0-indexed), if it's last occurrence of idx, we must have done nums[idx] decrements before this second on idx
            # Use approach: iterate, track free time
            free = 0
            need_marks = 0
            # We track decrements needed
            # iterate seconds, when we hit a last occurrence, we need nums[idx] decrements accumulated before
            total_decrements_needed = 0
            for i in range(s):
                if last.get(changeIndices[i]) == i:
                    # this is mark second, need to have done nums[changeIndices[i]-1] decrements before
                    need = nums[changeIndices[i]-1]
                    if free >= need:
                        free -= need
                        # this second used to mark (1 second)
                    else:
                        return False
                else:
                    free += 1
            return True
        
        lo, hi = 1, m
        ans = -1
        while lo <= hi:
            mid = (lo + hi) // 2
            if check(mid):
                ans = mid
                hi = mid - 1
            else:
                lo = mid + 1
        return ans
